commit.message:
feat(issue-platform): Allow issue occurrence information to be passed via eventstream (#42195)

We'll include this data in the `occurrence_data` key for any events that
have an `IssueOccurrence` passed along with them in eventstream.
This will be backwards compatible, since existing consumers can ignore
the new key.
